answer_1.quote: We evaluate on (i) the model's likelihood of predicting a compound in the masked language modelling task
answer_1.outputs: Predicted tokens for masked positions in sentences

answer_2.quote: We then compute two evaluation metrics by (i) directly comparing the predictions against the targets and (ii) characterizing their semantic relatedness based on an external linguistic resource. A partial match is formed if any of the n mask predictions contains the n th sub-token of the target compound (accuracy by dividing by the total number of mask tokens predicted), and a full match is formed if all n mask predictions contain matching sub-tokens of the target compound (accuracy by dividing by the total number of compounds in the evaluation data).
